text:
INT. SUBWAY PLATFORM - NIGHT

A COIN spins on the bench, slowing. PRIYA stops it with one finger without looking. DEV watches the tunnel mouth.

PRIYA
Your brother paid me in silence last time.

DEV
Silence spends. Tonight he needs noise.

PRIYA
Then buy a different courier. I don't shout for free.

She flicks the coin into the tracks. Sparks. Dev flinches. Priya is already walking toward the opposite train.
